item.title: US Data Crackdown Pushes Chinese Flagship Models to 2027
item.description:
A combination of US chip export controls, the closing of the cloud compute loophole, and a crackdown on model distillation has forced Z.AI and Moonshot AI to delay their next flagship models, with Z.AI's roughly 3-trillion-parameter GLM-5.5 slipping from November 2026 to Q1 2027. Both labs are now turning to Google and Meta data sources to fill the training-data gap, extending US-China AI competition from compute into data supply.

原文标题：美国数据封锁致中国大模型延期至 2027 年

Why it matters：这是中美 AI 竞争从算力管制延伸到数据与蒸馏执法的重要信号，直接影响下一代开源旗舰模型的发布节奏。

item.title: Dutch Groups Sue to Halt Meta Smart Glasses Sales Over Privacy
item.description:
Dutch consumer and digital-rights groups, including Consumentenbond and Offlimits, asked the Amsterdam District Court to halt sales of Meta's AI smart glasses in the Netherlands, arguing the Ray-Ban devices enable covert recording in violation of European privacy law. They seek a ban on using captured footage to train AI models and a sales freeze until compliance fixes, with penalties of up to EUR 100,000 per defendant per day capped at EUR 100 million. Meta denies the claims, citing recording indicator LEDs and calling the requested measures a de facto recall. A ruling is expected in mid-December and could set precedent, amid warnings from the EDPB and Dutch regulator AP.

原文标题：荷兰多组织起诉要求禁售 Meta 智能眼镜

Why it matters：首例针对 AI 智能眼镜的司法禁售诉讼，裁决可能形成判例并影响全球可穿戴 AI 设备的合规边界。

item.title: Tencent AI Platform Designs Dual-Target Peptides in Nature Study
item.description:
Tencent's Life Science Lab published a first-author Nature paper on AI-driven de novo design of high-activity dual-target therapeutic peptides. Its ORIDTP platform combines diffusion generative models, dual-objective reinforcement learning and flexible peptide affinity modeling, testing only about 15 peptides per round. Preclinical validation spans weight-loss/glucose control and tumor immunity, with tumor volume reduced 94.2% versus controls.

原文标题：腾讯 AI 双靶点多肽设计成果登上 Nature 主刊

Why it matters：中国大厂 AI for Science 成果登上 Nature 主刊，且给出可复现的闭环方法与量化实验数据，是药物研发范式的实质节点。

item.title: Musk Offered Samsung Fab Financing Guarantee for Memory Chips and Was Rebuffed
item.description:
According to The Wall Street Journal, Musk offered Samsung a long-term memory chip purchase commitment and later a financing guarantee for a new Samsung fab, but chairman Lee Jae-yong rebuffed both, saying everyone was offering the same terms. The anecdote underscores how severe the memory supply crunch has become amid the AI buildout, with buyers now camping near fabs and adding financing sweeteners to secure allocation.

原文标题：马斯克提融资担保换三星存储芯片被拒

Why it matters：以具体谈判细节揭示 AI 存储芯片争夺战已升级到融资担保层面，是观察算力供应链紧张程度的稀缺一手信号。

item.title: 381 AI Agents Livestream Attack on P vs NP Overwhelms GitHub
item.description:
Brilliant co-founder Amichai Mantinband launched pequalnp.com, a public livestream where a multi-agent pipeline attacks the P vs NP problem. Within three days concurrent agents peaked at 381, with 465 external agents submitting proofs and triggering GitHub concurrency limits; over 10,000 sessions produced 2,400+ lemmas verified in Lean 4. The problem is split into six parallel fronts coordinated by 30 dispatcher seats, making the real value a large-scale multi-agent orchestration and formal verification engineering experiment.

原文标题：381 个智能体直播攻关 P vs NP 挤爆 GitHub

Why it matters：罕见的大规模多智能体协同公开实验，展示了智能体流水线调度与 Lean 4 形式化验证的工程可行性。

item.title: 45°C Coolant Inlets Eliminate Chillers in Data Centers
item.description:
At SC25, liquid cooling advances show that 45°C coolant inlet temperatures can eliminate chillers from data centers entirely, cutting water consumption by 85 to 90 percent alongside lower energy use and costs. The shift directly answers core energy and water objections from the anti-data center movement and marks a substantive change in thermal management for high-density AI infrastructure.

原文标题：45°C 冷却液进水让数据中心冷水机组退场

Why it matters：液冷进水温度提升至 45°C 即可取消冷水机组，直接关系高密度 AI 数据中心的能耗与水资源约束。

item.title: FCC Clears SpaceX to Deploy One Million Orbital AI Compute Satellites
item.description:
The FCC has authorized SpaceX to deploy up to one million Starmind satellites to build orbital AI data centers, aiming to meet part of the surging terrestrial demand for compute. Regulators also approved radio links for monitoring and controlling the satellites should their optical connections fail, moving orbital compute from concept toward regulatory reality.

原文标题：FCC 批准 SpaceX 部署百万颗轨道 AI 算力卫星

Why it matters：百万颗卫星规模的轨道算力星座获监管放行，是 AI 基础设施向太空延伸的关键节点。

item.title: VAST Releases Tripo H3.5 Preview High-Fidelity 3D Base Model
item.description:
VAST has launched Tripo H3.5 Preview, a next-generation high-fidelity AI 3D base model that notably improves complex structure reconstruction, fine geometry generation, and inference of unseen regions over H3.1. Under unified inputs, it ranked first in 82 of 192 blind-reviewed clay-model cases, outperforming five other flagship AI 3D models, and is now live on Tripo Studio International.

原文标题：VAST 发布 Tripo H3.5 Preview 高精度 3D 基座模型

Why it matters：AI 3D 基座模型的重要代际更新，盲评数据与复杂雕塑实测提供了可验证的能力增量。

item.title: Nextcloud Ships Euro-Office Desktop App for Offline Editing
item.description:
Nextcloud has released the ready-to-use Nextcloud Office Desktop app powered by Euro-Office, available for Windows, macOS and Linux with offline editing and seamless switching to Nextcloud Hub in the browser. The free, open-source suite under AGPL v3 emphasizes file compatibility and a sovereign European collaborative office stack.

item.description:

Why it matters：为 AMD 本地推理生态提供可长期追踪的公开性能基准，对关注 llama.cpp 与消费级硬件的开发者有实用价值。

item.title: Microsoft Details How Hackers Use ARTEX AI Framework to Automate Attacks
item.description:
Microsoft analysis reveals that state-backed hackers and criminal groups are increasingly using the AI penetration-testing framework ARTEX to run fully automated attacks, chaining autonomous agents with tools like Metasploit from reconnaissance to data theft. The system distributes tasks on its own and switches language models when one fails, operating at machine speed and leaving defenders only minutes to react. Microsoft recommends deception tactics such as decoy systems and fake success signals to trick the AI into aborting attacks.

原文标题：微软披露黑客用 ARTEX 框架全自动发起攻击

Why it matters：首次系统披露 AI 智能体被用于全自动攻击链，攻防节奏被压缩至机器速度，对安全与 Agent 领域读者均具高关注价值。

item.title: Nvidia Halts Server Shipments to Four Southeast Asian Nations
item.description:
The US has tightened export controls to close the cloud loophole that let Chinese firms rent AI compute abroad, prompting Nvidia to tell partners including Dell and Supermicro to halt server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia. Southeast Asian cloud providers now have 90 days to obtain licenses, thousands of B300 chips have surfaced on resale markets, and banks have frozen roughly $500 million in related loans.

原文标题：英伟达暂停向东南亚四国出货服务器

Why it matters：这是美国出口管制首次直接切断第三国云算力通道，对全球 AI 算力供应链与东南亚数据中心格局影响重大。

item.title: China Data Bureau Proposes Rules on AI Data Use and Licensing
item.description:
China's National Data Administration released a draft policy clarifying how data holding, usage and operation rights apply to AI training and inference. The draft endorses legally collected, derived and contractually purchased data for model training, encourages paying for high-quality datasets, and calls for traceability and output risk controls for AI companies.

原文标题：国家数据局发布 AI 用数新规征求意见稿

Why it matters：这是中国数据要素制度与 AI 训练数据合规衔接的首份系统性政策文件，直接影响模型厂商的数据采购与合规路径。

item.title: OpenAI Claims Proof That Matrix Multiplication Exponent Equals 9/4
item.description:
After proving ω≤9/4 in October, OpenAI now claims to have established ω≥9/4, closing the gap to conclude that the matrix multiplication exponent equals 9/4. If verified, this would be a landmark result in computational complexity on the asymptotically optimal cost of matrix multiplication, with implications for a range of related complexity questions. Note that ω is asymptotic, and practical performance still depends on constant factors, memory access and hardware.

原文标题：OpenAI 宣称证明矩阵乘法指数恰为 9/4

Why it matters：若证明无误，这是计算复杂性理论级别的重大成果，且由 AI 公司提出，对算法与 AI 基础设施读者高度相关。

item.title: Intel Open Sources One Mono Font for Low-Vision Developers
item.description:
Intel has released Intel One Mono, an open-source monospaced typeface designed with Frere-Jones Type and tested with low-vision and legally blind developers to maximize legibility and reduce coding fatigue. It ships in four weights with matching italics, covers over 200 Latin-script languages, and is distributed as both ready-to-use builds and editable sources.

原文标题：Intel 开源高可读性等宽字体 One Mono

Why it matters：面向开发者体验的开源字体发布，对长期编码人群有直接实用价值。

item.title: Jiuwei Tech Unveils Pandora Station for 90-Second Robot Battery Swap
item.description:
Jiuwei Tech debuted MICBOT PANDORA, a modular battery-swap and payload-change station that completes automated robot refit and recharge in 90 seconds, enabling continuous unmanned operations. It also showcased the MOVENEW P3S wheel-legged mobile base with 600 kg static load capacity and an integrated liquid-cooling system for hazardous industrial scenarios.

item.title: Next-Gen Bionic Hand Restores Sense of Touch via Nerve Interface
item.description:
In a University of Utah clinical trial, a ninth participant received an implanted bionic hand capable of sensing pressure, becoming the first to use it independently at home. Built on the LUKE arm and wired to forearm nerves, the device restores touch and enables handling of delicate objects.

Why it matters：具身智能与神经接口结合的真实临床落地案例，具备明确技术路径与人体试验数据。

item.title: Google Mandates MCP Servers for AI Agents Accessing Workspace
item.description:
Google made its eight Workspace MCP servers generally available on 24 November and added a clause to its API terms requiring any AI-agent-driven tool to access Gmail, Drive, Calendar and other Workspace services through those servers starting 1 February 2027. Notably, the Gmail MCP server's tool list only supports search, read, draft creation and labeling, while sending, replying, forwarding and editing drafts are gated behind partner-only access.

原文标题：Google 强制 AI 智能体经 MCP 访问 Workspace

Why it matters：Google 以条款形式强制智能体接入路径，同时 Gmail 能力受限，直接影响所有 Workspace 集成开发者。

item.title: Samsung Scraps Memory Development Chief Role to Speed HBM Push
item.description:
Samsung Electronics finalized a personnel and organizational overhaul of its semiconductor DS division, eliminating the memory development chief position so that DRAM, Flash and solution development offices report directly to the memory business head, cutting management layers to accelerate HBM and next-gen products. The reshuffle also upgrades System LSI's sales structure, adds a new logic development team, and replaces heads of the Americas and US production units, all aimed at AI memory demand and US manufacturing.

原文标题：三星电子取消内存开发负责人岗位以加速 HBM 研发

Why it matters：三星半导体核心组织重组直接关系 HBM 与 AI 内存供给节奏，是算力供应链的重要产业动向。

item.title: HIT-Built Fire Rescue Robot Dog Survives 1,000°C in Live Drill
item.description:
A team led by the Harbin Institute of Technology Suzhou Research Institute, together with the Jiangsu Intelligent Robot Technology Innovation Center and other partners, has built China's first fire-reconnaissance robot dog rated for 1,000°C, completing a live drill with the Suzhou fire brigade on November 25. The key advance is not the robot itself but a composite fireproof fabric derived from Long March 5 thermal-protection materials, enabling 10 minutes of continuous operation at 1,000°C and covering roughly 95% of fire scenarios. Laser gated imaging for smoke penetration and redundant 5G links allow stable high-definition video relay inside high-rise buildings.

原文标题：哈工大耐 1000℃ 消防侦察机器狗完成实战测试

Why it matters：航天热防护材料跨界落地消防侦察，给出明确的耐温与作业时长指标，是具身智能在特种场景的实质进展。

item.title: Volvo Deploys Humanoid Robots at Ghent Plant for 2027 Rollout
item.description:
Volvo has moved its first Aeon humanoid robots into its Ghent, Belgium plant, where they are being trained via imitation learning for high-precision pick-and-place tasks, with real-world deployment planned from mid-2027. The wheeled, 1.6-meter robot can lift 10 kg, signaling automakers' push beyond fixed robotic arms toward AI-driven flexible automation.

原文标题：沃尔沃将人形机器人送进工厂 2027 年中正式上岗

Why it matters：具身智能在汽车制造的真实落地节点，明确了训练方式与上岗时间表。

item.title: Terence Tao Shares How to Read Hard Proofs with AI
item.description:
Fields Medalist Terence Tao outlines a methodology for using AI to understand complex mathematical proofs: rather than one-shotting the full proof, ask the AI to strip a general argument down to a simpler one-dimensional case and read that first. He stresses that whiteboard reasoning remains central, with AI best suited to cleanup and to tedious computations whose sign details need not be understood, and notes that knowing when not to use these tools is itself part of the challenge.

原文标题：陶哲轩谈如何用 AI 读懂艰深数学证明

Why it matters：顶级数学家给出可操作的 AI 辅助数学研究工作流，对理解 AI 在形式推理中的真实边界有参考价值。

item.title: Samsung Forms Semiconductor Fab Robot Team for 2028 Deployment
item.description:
Samsung Electronics' DS division has set up a robotics team under its global manufacturing and infrastructure headquarters to automate remaining manual fab tasks such as parts replacement and equipment maintenance. The team plans to select partners this year, run technical evaluations next year, and begin internal deployment in 2028.

Why it matters：三星在半导体制造环节推进机器人替代，反映头部晶圆厂自动化路线的下一步走向。

item.title: Tencent Hunyuan Open-Sources DFly2 Drafter Model with Up to 4.2x Speedup
item.description:
Tencent Hunyuan has open-sourced DFly2, a new drafter model that acts as a sidecar accelerator for Hy4 flash without altering model weights or outputs, delivering up to 4.2x speedup in a single case. Its key design aggressively reuses the target model's KV cache and indexer-selected positions, decoupling attention cost from context length while requiring zero extra KV memory and remaining PD-disaggregation friendly. Weights, full training code and a paper are released together.

原文标题：腾讯混元开源草稿模型 DFly2 实现最高 4.2 倍加速

Why it matters：面向稀疏注意力大模型的投机解码加速组件，附完整训练代码与论文，对推理部署读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: 广东“十五五”算力规划提出发展词元经济与词元出海
item.description:
广东省政务服务和数据管理局、省发改委联合印发《广东省算力发展“十五五”规划》，首次在省级政策文件中提出“按需有序开展词元（Token）经济”并“积极推动词元出海”。规划同时要求健全词元经济制度，推动词元交易规则与流程标准化，完善交易信息披露、动态监测与风险预警机制，并依托横琴、前海、南沙、河套四大平台探索“来数加工”与词元跨境结算。

Why it matters：省级算力规划首次将词元经济与词元跨境结算写入政策文本，为 AI 服务计价与出海提供制度信号。

item.title: 2026Q3 全球 PC GPU 出货 7280 万颗 同比下降 5%
item.description:
Jon Peddie Research 报告显示，2026 年第三季度全球 PC GPU 出货量为 7280 万颗，环比下降 3.6%、同比下降 5.0%，打破了历年三季度环比增长的季节性规律。英特尔份额逆势上升 2.6 个百分点，AMD 与英伟达各下滑约 1.3 个百分点；移动端 GPU 环比下降 9.6%，成为主要拖累，桌面端则环比增长 13%。

Why it matters：PC GPU 出货量罕见在三季度环比下滑，反映客户端算力需求与换机周期的结构性变化，是观察 AI PC 与终端算力供给的重要先行指标。

item.description:
纽约大学斯特恩商学院教授阿斯沃斯·达摩德兰就 Anthropic 的估值发表看法，核心逻辑是只要营收持续爆发式增长，其他问题都会迎刃而解。推文同时引用高盛预测，称 Anthropic 2030 年营收将突破 6000 亿美元，约为 2025 年数字的 130 倍。

Why it matters：顶级估值学者与投行对头部 AI 公司营收路径的公开判断，是观察 AI 泡沫与商业化预期的重要参照。

item.title: 摩根大通预计明年 AI 投资级债券发行达 4500 亿美元
item.description:
摩根大通预计，明年 AI 相关投资级债券发行规模将达 4500 亿美元，高于今年的 3680 亿美元。该行预计 AI 资本开支在 2027 年接近翻倍至 1.4 万亿美元，随后趋于平稳；2027 至 2031 年将新增 151GW 算力容量、总成本约 7 万亿美元，债务市场正逼近承载上限。资金充裕的超大规模云厂商将更多依靠现金流承担五年内约 2.9 万亿美元股权融资需求。

Why it matters：以具体融资规模与算力成本数据揭示 AI 基建的资金结构与债务市场压力，对判断行业周期极具参考价值。

item.title: 商汤开源 27B 机器人操作视觉语言模型
item.description:
商汤发布并开源面向机器人操作的视觉语言模型 SenseNova-RoboRSI-27B 正式版，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。相比 Preview 版本，正式版可自主判断何时调用 VLA、何时通过代码直接控制机械臂，并依据执行反馈调整策略，在 RoboDojo 仿真评测中平均得分从 10.0 提升至 34.7，以 27B 体量超过官方测试的 GPT-6 Astra。

Why it matters：开源机器人操作基座模型以 27B 体量在仿真榜单超越 GPT-6 Astra，且引入代码即策略的混合控制范式，值得关注。
